user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Terraforming Garden Dome. Inside a terraforming dome on a barren world: a lush garden of young trees and crop beds under the geodesic glass, an irrigation gantry misting the plants, a curved walkway with railings, a monitoring station with holographic readouts, birds? none — small pollinator drones instead, and through the dome panels a raging orange dust storm scouring the dead plain outside. Style: solar-punk sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
